provider: Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg / Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin (Umweltatlas)
attribution: Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg / Einwohnerdichte 2023 (Umweltatlas), WFS ua_einwohnerdichte_2023, CC BY 3.0 DE; transformed to EPSG:4326.

limitations: Measures melderechtlich registrierte Einwohner (main residence) on 31.12.2023 per ISU5 block or block part (Blockkarte 1:5000, Raumbezug Umweltatlas 2022). It does not measure daytime population, workers, visitors, tourists or secondary residences.

Counts are published only above 2: a published 0 means 0-2 residents. Such blocks are stored with residents and density missing (status suppressed), never as 0. Age-band cells follow the same >2 rule: 0 means 0-2 and is stored as null in a complete age breakdown; a published age value of 1 or 2 fails validation.
Density is residents per hectare of the whole block area as published (ew_ha_2023), including non-residential parts of the block; it is not a net residential density.
Umweltatlas product with its own reference date and spatial basis; totals differ from the official half-yearly LOR population (berlin_population). Do not mix or substitute the two.
Each block is assigned whole to the LOR Planungsraum with the largest overlap (EPSG:25833); block and LOR geometries are not reconciled, partial and ambiguous overlaps are flagged.
Source access, CRS, paging and field mapping checked 2026-10-18. The companion layer einwohnerdichte2023_entw (change 2022-2023) is not ingested.
